title: Leveraging Binary Hashing for Scalable Index Assignment in Semantic Communications
abstract: arXiv:2611.21260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transmitting semantically structured embedding vectors over digital channels is costly in bit rate, while conven- tional vector quantization approaches face limitations in scalabil- ity, encoding complexity, and index assignment. This paper inves- tigates binary hashing techniques from the information retrieval literature as semantic indexing strategies for general-purpose networks. We study random Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) along with Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-, Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA)-, and ITQ (Iterative Quantization)- based variants in a semantic communication pipeline over a Binary Symmetric Channel. Embeddings are compressed into binary codes, reconstructed through Hamming retrieval from a shared table, and evaluated on downstream classification. translated_title: 利用二进制哈希实现语义通信中可扩展的索引分配
translated_abstract: 在数字信道上传输语义结构化的嵌入向量在比特率方面代价高昂，而传统的向量量化方法在可扩展性、编码复杂度和索引分配方面存在局限。本文研究了信息检索文献中的二进制哈希技术，将其作为通用网络的语义索引策略。我们在基于二进制对称信道的语义通信流水线中，研究了随机局部敏感哈希（LSH）以及基于主成分分析（PCA）、典型相关分析（CCA）和迭代量化（ITQ）的变体。嵌入向量被压缩为二进制码，通过从共享码表中进行的汉明检索来重构，并在下游分类任务上进行评估。在Massive Text Embedding Benchmark（MTEB）和Banking77数据集上的实验表明，数据依赖的哈希方法优于随机LSH，而ITQ则……
tldr: 本论文将信息检索领域的二进制哈希技术（包括基于PCA、CCA和ITQ的变体）引入语义通信系统，作为可扩展的语义索引分配策略，通过二进制码压缩与汉明检索重构嵌入向量，并证明数据依赖的哈希方法优于随机LSH。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces binary hashing techniques from information retrieval (including PCA-, CCA-, and ITQ-based variants) into semantic communications as a scalable semantic index assignment strategy, compressing embeddings into binary codes with Hamming retrieval reconstruction, and demonstrates that data-dependent hashing outperforms random LSH.
